newsitem.title: MEXICO: AHMSA says Q4 sales volume up 11.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: AHMSA says Q4 sales volume up 11.2 pct.

text.p: Steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) said sales volumes grew 11.2 percent to 723,000 tonnes in the fourth quarter of 1996 from the same period in 1995, a company director said Wednesday.

Domestic volume sold in the time period was 593,000 tonnes, a growth of 32.7 percent compared with the fourth quarter in 1995 and a 12.7 percent increase over the third quarter in 1996, said the Ahmsa official, who declined to be unnamed.
He said direct exports in the last quarter of 1996 were 130,000 tonnes, or 18 percent of total volume. In the fourth quarter of 1995, exports were 203,000 tonnes, or 31 percent of total tonnage.
"This is basically due to the recovery that has been seen in the domestic market, not because we are reducing our export efforts," he said.
Ahmsa aims for exports to total between 20 to 25 percent of total volume in 1997, he added.
